event._comment: REAL HISTORICAL DATA. Every figure below is a publicly reported fact about Meta Platforms' Q4 2021 earnings release, manually transcribed from the cited sources. Nothing in this file is estimated, simulated, or model-derived.
event.announcement_context: Reported after the regular market close on Feb 2, 2022. The first full trading session to react was Feb 3, 2022.
event.dau_qoq_change: First-ever reported sequential (quarter-over-quarter) decline in Facebook daily active users since the metric was first disclosed.
stated_headwinds: Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT) privacy changes, estimated by Meta at roughly $10 billion of full-year 2022 revenue impact
Increasing competition for user attention from short-form video apps, notably TikTok
Continued heavy investment (Reality Labs / metaverse) with limited near-term revenue
event.market_cap_loss_note: Widely reported as the largest single-day market-capitalization loss for a US company at the time; contemporaneous press estimates of the exact dollar figure range from about $230B to $251B depending on the share count and timing used.
event.reason_for_selecting_event: This is one of the cleanest large-sample earnings events in modern market history: a single, unambiguous catalyst (the Feb 2, 2022 report) produced an extreme, statistically obvious price reaction (-26.4% the next session) on record volume, with a well-defined and widely corroborated set of facts (EPS miss, revenue beat, first-ever DAU decline, weak guidance) and dense contemporaneous news coverage. Because the reaction is so large relative to normal daily noise, it is unusually well suited to a student event-study and diffusion-model project: the signal-to-noise ratio is high, the announcement timing is unambiguous (after-hours on a single date), and every input figure is independently verifiable from multiple public sources without any paid data vendor.
